bug.title: Privacy: Correctly escape page title in `get_the_privacy_policy_link()`
bug.body: Reported in Trac #64748. HTML tags inside the privacy policy page title render as escaped entities instead of markup. WordPress permits a limited set of tags in page titles. Reproduced by test_get_the_privacy_policy_link_should_allow_supported_title_markup.

attempts.output: PHPUnit 9.6.38 F There was 1 failure: 1) Tests_Link_GetThePrivacyPolicyLink::test_get_the_privacy_policy_link_should_allow_supported_title_markup Failed asserting that two strings are equal. --- Expected +++ Actual -'Privacy' +'<strong>Privacy</strong>' FAILURES! Tests: 1, Failures: 1.
